stage0076_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「...T-that's the full account of how the Unicorn was seized.」

stage0076_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マーサ$$
「As I thought, Neo Zeon still hasn't
　given up trying to recover the box, it seems.」

stage0076_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Neo Zeon... or rather,
　should I say $$フル・フロンタル$$?」

stage0076_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I hear $c will resupply here at
　$$メリダ島$$, then head for Dakar. Could you
　arrange for troops there as well?」

stage0076_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Why?
　Reinforcements for $c, said to be the
　Federation's strongest? Isn't that nonsense?」

stage0076_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「But after so many battles,
　they're worn out too...」

stage0076_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Seems you've grown attached to them.
　'Eaten from the same pot,' is that it?」

stage0076_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マーサ$$
「I'm afraid I can't grant that request.
　Federation High Command has no intention
　of sending troops to Dakar.」

stage0076_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then what happens to Dakar
　and $c!?」

stage0076_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Seems you care about them more than the box.」

stage0076_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$マーサ$$
「No need to worry about the box.
　Those above will sort it out nicely.」

stage0076_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マーサ$$
「As for the matter of $$ミネバ$$ Zabi,
　I'll speak with the right people myself.」

stage0076_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Your assignment has reached a stopping point.
　Leave the unit, using the pretext of taking
　the Enhanced Human you captured to Augusta.」

stage0076_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Augusta's Newtype Research Institute...
　I heard that place had been shut down...」

stage0076_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$マーサ$$
「The facilities for re-conditioning still remain.」

stage0076_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「What are you planning to do?」

stage0076_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$マーサ$$
「...I said not to worry about the box earlier,
　but it never hurts to be extra careful...」

stage0076_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$マーサ$$
「I don't know what goals Grandfather
　and $$カーディアス$$ had, but if the box is lost,
　the Foundation's prosperity is lost too.」

stage0076_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Understood.
　...What about the mobile suit she was using?」

stage0076_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$マーサ$$
「It's no longer needed.
　I'll have a different unit prepared for her.」

stage0076_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then I'll leave that four-winged unit with $c.」

stage0076_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Laplace's Box is our lifeline...
　I'm counting on you, $$アルベルト$$.」

stage0076_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（The world might be ending,
　and just what am I doing here...）

stage0076_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text: ～ $$ローナン・マーセナス$$'s Private Residence, Office ～

stage0076_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$リディ$$
「...Sounded like a complicated talk.
　Who were you speaking with?」

stage0076_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ローナン$$
「$$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$...
　Even in the military, you must've heard the name.」

stage0076_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$リディ$$
（So that's the one people took to be
　$$アルベルト$$'s superior...）

stage0076_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ローナン$$
「That woman... asking the impossible, as always...」

stage0076_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ローナン$$
「You don't need to know.」

stage0076_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$リディ$$
「It's about $$オードリー$$... about $$ミネバ$$ Zabi, isn't it?」

stage0076_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$リディ$$
「I know she must be causing you trouble...
　But she's...」

stage0076_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ローナン$$
「You fell for her, didn't you?」

stage0076_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ローナン$$
「Deserting the military and running here for her...
　It's the same as when you said you wanted
　to be a pilot and stormed out of the house.」

stage0076_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ローナン$$
「Who'd have thought you'd be tangled up with the box...」

stage0076_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ローナン$$
「That's the fate of the House of Marcenas.」

stage0076_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ローナン$$
「You... must know the truth of the Marcenas family.」

stage0076_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$リディ$$
「Are you telling me to live as a politician?」

stage0076_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ローナン$$
「You don't have that talent.
　But now that it's come to this, you'll succeed me
　and inherit the Marcenas family's fate.」

stage0076_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$リディ$$
「What is this, all of a sudden...!?
　What is this 'fate of the Marcenas family'...!」

stage0076_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ローナン$$
「$$リディ$$...
　Have you never heard the name Chrono?」

stage0076_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ローナン$$
「From that look, it seems you're not entirely
　unfamiliar with it...」

stage0076_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ローナン$$
「You must resolve yourself to this.
　The head of the Marcenas family must
　serve as one of its members.」

stage0076_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミネバ$$
（$$バナージ$$, $$ハマーン$$...
　Was what I did the right thing...）

stage0076_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, is it not rude to enter without knocking?」

stage0076_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「What's wrong?
　When is my meeting with Assemblyman Marcenas?」

stage0076_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$リディ$$
「...I've learned what a pitiful family it is.」

stage0076_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$リディ$$
「This family... is rotten.
　They'd stop at nothing to protect their position...」

stage0076_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$リディ$$
「They'd even use you as a hostage again...」

stage0076_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$リディ$$
「I... brought you somewhere terrible...
　And here I thought I could help you...!」

stage0076_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$リディ$$
「No matter what happens, I'll protect you.
　So please, stay here... by my side...
　Don't... leave me alone...!」

stage0076_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$リディ$$
「Give up Zeon and the Zabi family both, and
　become part of the Marcenas. Then even Father...」

stage0076_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$リディ$$
「Even if it's just for show, that's fine.
　This fruitless conflict will end, and you'll
　be able to gain your freedom too...!」

stage0076_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「...That kind of freedom...
　You think that can be called freedom...?」

stage0076_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$オットー$$
「I won't pretend it was mutual.
　...You put me through plenty.
　I won't be forgetting that face for a while.」

stage0076_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Still, with the Unicorn seized,
　I'm surprised you're the one leaving the unit.」

stage0076_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's exactly why.
　I need to return to HQ and think up a plan.」

stage0076_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Still, I can't accept that Anaheim
　intervened in $$マリーダ・クルス$$'s transfer.」

stage0076_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Entrusting a prisoner to a private company
　shouldn't be conceivable, under normal circumstances.」

stage0076_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「It's headquarters' decision.
　I'm just here to carry out orders.」

stage0076_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Please look after $$マリーダ$$, Mr. $$アルベルト$$.
　She's grown quite weak from repeated battles.」

stage0076_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Leave it to me.
　...I'll pray for your safety in battle.」

stage0076_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「For someone so passionate about the Unicorn,
　he's oddly casual about it now.」

stage0076_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$オットー$$
「Well... he never had much personal
　affection for $$バナージ$$ to begin with.」

stage0076_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アムロ$$
（It's not simple displeasure or dislike...
　Mr. $$アルベルト$$ may have known something
　about $$バナージ$$ that we don't...）

stage0076_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アムロ$$
（But his last words alone were sincere.
　He must have felt something here too.）

stage0076_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain... word's in from Captain
　Testarossa: they're ready to set sail.」

stage0076_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$オットー$$
「I'm counting on you,
　Captain $$アムロ$$, $$カミーユ$$. We'll draw them off.」

stage0076_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Understood. I'll protect Dakar
　and rescue $$バナージ$$, no matter what.」

stage0076_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$アレク$$
「Quit slacking, $$フラスト$$.
　Get moving.」

stage0076_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Easy for you to say. The $$ガランシェール$$'s
　buried in sand. No way we dig her out alone.」

stage0076_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$トムラ$$
「Can't be helped, we forced a landing
　after that trouble. Be glad the engines
　didn't blow.」

stage0076_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Tch... what rotten luck, running into
　a Federation unit crossing the Sahara.」

stage0076_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ベッソン$$
「$$ギルボア$$... can't we deploy
　a $$ギラ・ズール$$?」

stage0076_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「No good. Blow the hatch from inside
　and we'll wreck the $$ガランシェール$$
　itself.」

stage0076_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Damn it! We finally caught the Split-Horn,
　and look at the state we're in!」

stage0076_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アレク$$
「Guess all we can do now is bet on the Captain.」

stage0076_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Heading for Dakar on foot, linking up
　with the unit ahead, then coming back
　to rescue the $$ガランシェール$$... rough job.」

stage0076_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$トムラ$$
「But why did the Captain bring
　that Federation pilot along, I wonder?」

stage0076_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$フラスト$$
「He just looked the most free, I guess.」

stage0076_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$トムラ$$
「But that $$バナージ$$ kid... will he be okay?
　He looked like an empty shell back there...」

stage0076_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ギルボア$$
（$$バナージ$$...
　are you really going to end like this...）

stage0076_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You look pretty worn out.」

stage0076_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You want me to tell you to hang in there?」

stage0076_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So just leave me alone. I'm done with it,
　getting involved in things, being used
　by people...」

stage0076_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Can't do that.
　You're a pilot... someone who fights.」

stage0076_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that how you made
　Ms. $$マリーダ$$ fight, too?」

stage0076_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Just because it's war... doing that,
　turning a person into that... it can't
　be allowed!」

stage0076_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm sick of it!
　War... fighting, all of it!」

stage0076_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Your eyes... they're the eyes of a man
　who decides his own life and death.」

stage0076_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Then grit your teeth till you die.
　A man's life is a fight to the end.」

stage0076_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$バナージ$$
（That's how $$カーディアス・ビスト$$...
　my father, too, told me to fight...
　but...）

stage0076_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I did it...
　I fought! With everything I had!
　And this is what it got me!!」

stage0076_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I got in a mobile suit, I killed people,
　and now I'm walking through a desert!」

stage0076_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What more do you want from me!
　What am I even supposed to fight!!」

stage0076_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Drink. It'll warm you up.」

stage0076_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Scorching by day, freezing by night...
　this desert's a real pain.」

stage0076_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Mr. $$ジンネマン$$, you were in
　a POW camp in Africa, right...」

stage0076_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Sounds like you heard that from $$フラスト$$.」

stage0076_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I heard why you and the $$ガランシェール$$'s
　crew fight, too.」

stage0076_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That guy... telling more than he should...」

stage0076_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「What's wrong?
　Feeling sorry for us?」

stage0076_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...I can't put it into words, but
　I just... I can't fight anymore...」

stage0076_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$ said the same thing.
　That the Federation's preparing
　to attack the colonies.」

stage0076_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If this fighting keeps up, the world
　will end. And then more people like
　Ms. $$マリーダ$$ will...」

stage0076_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「If you're sick of the Federation, bring
　the Unicorn and come with us.」

stage0076_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Lost sight of what's right, huh...」

stage0076_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「But... we're the same way...
　no, everyone in the world is.」

stage0076_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I hated the Federation so much,
　I left $$マリーダ$$ behind and carried
　out the mission...」

stage0076_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Maybe a man like me has no right
　to avenge his wife and child...」

stage0076_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「But there's no turning back for us now.」

stage0076_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「It's not like Zeon beating the Federation
　would save anything, and I don't care
　what's inside that box...」

stage0076_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「It's just... curse the world and die
　in a ditch, or keep fighting a war
　that never ends. That's all we had.」

stage0076_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Look, $$バナージ$$.
　All those stars shining up there.」

stage0076_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「But us... even looking at stars
　like that, our hearts are dried up...」

stage0076_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I've seen the night sky's stars
　plenty of times before... it's strange.」

stage0076_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Makes it hard to believe Earth's
　supposed to be so polluted...」

stage0076_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「But even this sky's dirtier than it
　used to be. The desert's crept right
　up to Dakar's doorstep, they say.」

stage0076_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「It's all humanity's own doing.
　Reckless development, Colony Drops,
　massive battles...」

stage0076_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「If people are creatures born of nature,
　then the trash and poison we make
　are nature's products too.」

stage0076_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「And if the world ends up uninhabitable,
　I guess that's just nature finding
　its own balance.」

stage0076_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Nature has no mercy in it.
　People used to know that, as an
　instinct born of nature itself...」

stage0076_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So we built civilization to survive,
　built societies to protect ourselves...」

stage0076_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Yeah... but it got so complicated that
　before we knew it, we had to live just
　to keep the system running.」

stage0076_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「And in the end, that made life harder,
　so to escape that backwards mess,
　we went looking for a new world in space.」

stage0076_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「And there, another system took shape,
　one meant to give hope to Spacenoids
　cast off in space, and guide their lives.」

stage0076_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ms. $$マリーダ$$ said the same thing.」

stage0076_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「The old order left on Earth denied it.
　Different roots never mesh -
　one just tries to crush the other.」

stage0076_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But a unified Federation, with ten
　billion people living in space...
　that must've been a pipe dream once.」

stage0076_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Isn't that a possibility too, for people?
　That two ways of thinking could
　become one, someday...」

stage0076_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Not everyone got bound together
　as equals. The grudges of those cast
　out and crushed still cling to this Earth.」

stage0076_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Yeah, it is sad. We're supposed to
　live so it won't be, so why is it
　still like this...」

stage0076_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$ left to stop the world's
　sadness too, didn't she...」

stage0076_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「What about you, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0076_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Weren't you and your friends
　fighting for that too?」

stage0076_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Not for the two ways of thinking
　we couldn't let go of, but for that
　chance you spoke of, becoming one.」

stage0076_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I know. You're going to say a man
　shouldn't cry in front of others, right?」

stage0076_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「No... tears shed thinking of someone
　else are different. I don't trust a man
　who never cries no matter what.」

stage0076_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$ and Lady $$ミネバ$$ believed in you.
　You can't be a weak man.」

stage0076_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Cry now, $$バナージ$$.
　...Let it all out.
　Your heart isn't dead yet, not completely.」

stage0076_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「It's just me and the stars here.
　...But once your tears run dry, we move out.」

stage0076_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「The living have to do something.
　Whether it's out of hatred, or for
　someone else's sake.」

stage0076_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$オードリー$$... everyone...
　I...）

stage0076_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I hear $$ハマーン$$ is heading to $$アクシズ$$
　along with $$ギュネイ$$ and $$クェス$$.」

stage0076_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you weren't able to reclaim Lady $$ミネバ$$...?」

stage0076_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シャア$$
「Let her do as she pleases.
　There's no need to rely on the Zabi
　bloodline at this point.」

stage0076_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You may say that, but the Zabi name
　still carries influence.」

stage0076_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I know it may not sit well with you,
　Supreme Commander, but let me suggest
　we make good use of her.」

stage0076_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$シャア$$
「That kind of thinking is what saddled
　$$ミネバ$$ with that burden...」

stage0076_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That, too, is simply fate, I suppose.」

stage0076_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$シャア$$
「Are you saying I, who carry on the Zeon
　name, am much the same?」

stage0076_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I believe it's precisely because you had
　that resolve that you rose up, Supreme
　Commander.」

stage0076_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Let's hear your excuse for $$アムロ$$'s
　assassination.」

stage0076_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I want to see $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s true resolve.」

stage0076_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$ is just one Federation pilot,
　while you're Neo Zeon's Supreme Commander...
　Surely there's a fitting way to fight, then.」

stage0076_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$シャア$$
「Are you saying that's what you proved...?」

stage0076_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll accept whatever reprimand you have
　for overstepping my bounds.」

stage0076_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But now that you've resolved to part
　ways with $c, I intend to use whatever
　means necessary to secure victory.」

stage0076_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$シャア$$
「And Laplace's Box is one of them...」

stage0076_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The more trump cards, the better.
　Just having them in hand matters, even
　if they never come into play.」

stage0076_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'll grant you that.
　But I don't care for stirring up the
　Zeon remnants to do it.」

stage0076_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then it's just a fight to settle old
　grudges from the $$一年戦争$$.」

stage0076_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「As I explained earlier, this isn't the
　time to be picky about our methods.」

stage0076_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$シャア$$
「Are you headed down to Earth as well?」

stage0076_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No... there's someone better suited
　to take Dakar, so I've left it to them.」

stage0076_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Dakar must hold memories for you too,
　Supreme Commander...」

stage0076_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The place where they marched into the
　Earth Federation's parliament building
　and invoked the name $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0076_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Then, if you'll excuse me.」

stage0076_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$シャア$$
（They used the name $$シャア・アズナブル$$...?）

stage0076_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$シャア$$
（What's going on...?
　I only went back to being
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$ after the $$新世時空震動$$.）

stage0076_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$フル・フロンタル$$... just who are you...?）

stage0076_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「...The $$ガランシェール$$'s sailing looks fine.」

stage0076_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That's one less thing to worry about.」

stage0076_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Buried in sand until a moment ago,
　and still one tough ship.」

stage0076_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アレク$$
「Speaking of tough, so are you, Captain.
　You really did link up with the other
　unit on foot, after all.」

stage0076_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「If we're talking tough, $$バナージ$$ counts too.」

stage0076_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「My thanks, $$バナージ$$.
　If you hadn't been there, I might have
　given out partway through.」

stage0076_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not... I only held you back...」

stage0076_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Just having someone to match wills with
　makes all the difference.」

stage0076_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Another new member for the $$ガランシェール$$
　crew? That's a bad habit of yours,
　Captain.」

stage0076_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Me, in the $$ガランシェール$$ crew...」

stage0076_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$フラスト$$
「If the Federation and Neo Zeon are all
　the same to you, just pick whichever
　feels more comfortable.」

stage0076_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$アレク$$
「You're the $$ガランシェール$$'s savior.
　You're welcome here.」

stage0076_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Don't rush it.
　First, there's something $$バナージ$$ needs
　to do at Dakar.」

stage0076_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Activating the Laplace Program... is it...」

stage0076_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「The invasion of Dakar is the day after
　tomorrow. Once the local unit secures
　the city, we'll drop you and the Unicorn in.」

stage0076_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$フラスト$$
「The local unit... you mean those guys?」

stage0076_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Their skill's supposed to be solid.
　And they've got a trump card besides.」

stage0076_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Thanks to you.
　I appreciate the help.」

stage0076_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ロニ$$
「We share the same cause.
　I only did what was natural.」

stage0076_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ロニ$$
「I can somehow tell...
　I can feel things like possibility...
　hope... a future... from you.」

stage0076_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ロニ$$
「I'm $$ロニ・ガーベイ$$.
　...Would you tell me your name?」

stage0076_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm... $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

stage0076_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Nice to meet you, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0076_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, Master $$マデューカス$$...
　This battle can only be described
　as truly magnificent.」

stage0076_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「As long as Captain Testarossa and I
　command this $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, we have
　no equal. That's all I've proven.」

stage0076_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$c's members seemed surprised too.
　In fact, it produced 100Z worth of
　Z-Chips. I'll add these to the squad's stock.」

stage0076_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Hmm... for a robot, you seem to
　understand things rather well.」

stage0076_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「But I've received reports on your conduct
　from $$ＳＲＴ$$ personnel, starting with
　Sergeant Major $$メリッサ・マオ$$.」

stage0076_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「This ship will continue operations
　alongside $c, but during that time, I'll
　allow no one near Captain Testarossa.」

stage0076_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「If you break this rule,
　I intend to take resolute action.
　Do you understand what that means?」

stage0076_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Very well.
　Let me lay out a clear punishment.
　Should you break the rule...」

stage0076_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「I'll lash you to $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s bow
　and rapid-dive to crush depth!
　By God and Her Majesty, I'll tear you apart!」

stage0076_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Th-this... looks like asking $$テッサ$$ for
　the occasional commercial is going
　to be tough...）

stage0076_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Cheer up, $$ミコット$$.
　$$カミーユ$$ said $$バナージ$$'s sure to be fine,
　remember?」

stage0076_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ミコット$$
「...Of course I'm worried about $$バナージ$$
　too. But... shouldn't we be thinking
　more about ourselves?」

stage0076_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Our employer $$アルベルト$$ is gone now, so...
　we really don't have a place
　in $c anymore.」

stage0076_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's not true.
　I'm working as $$アストナージ$$'s assistant.」

stage0076_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Lately they even let me tinker with the
　Gundam. Every day's way more fulfilling
　than back at Anaheim Tech.」

stage0076_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Sure, combat still scares me, but
　I'm part of $c too. I intend to see
　where this fight leads.」

stage0076_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Can't let $$バナージ$$ outdo me, after all.
　Besides, $$オードリー$$'s working hard too.」

stage0076_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ミコット$$
「...Could I do it too, I wonder...」

stage0076_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Course you can.
　With $$オードリー$$ gone, I hear the chores
　crew is short-handed anyway.」

stage0076_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Thanks, $$タクヤ$$.
　I'll... try a little harder.」

stage0076_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right, Master $$ミコット$$.
　Once you're done with the chores crew,
　please come help me out too.」

stage0076_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's all three do our best!」

stage0076_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Let's get fired up today too!」

stage0076_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ミコット$$
（$$オードリー$$...
　I'll never forget about you...）
